description: On the E026 tip (commit da18628: compiled batched Muon, 2@16 + 2@24 + 4@32 px, 8.0 epochs), change only the schedule to 3@16 + 1@24 + 4@32 px, so epoch 2 moves from 24 px to 16 px. Keep the same operator (flip + translate-2 at 32 px, then antialiased bilinear downsample), AdaptiveMaxPool2d(1), and Muon/SGD hyperparameters. The step count is unchanged, so the LR/EMA/lookahead schedules are unchanged too. All shapes are already warmed up in build.
